blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A vlogger faces a 90-day preventive suspension of his driver’s license after the Land Transportation Office (LTO) flagged him for alleged road safety violations in Palawan, including riding a motorcycle without a helmet. The LTO, under Assistant Secretary Markus Lacanilao, also issued a show-cause order (SCO) directing the vlogger to explain the alleged violations. According to the LTO Mimaropa (Mindoro Occidental, Mindoro Oriental, Marinduque, Romblon, and Palawan), photos and videos circulating on social media showed the unnamed vlogger riding a motorcycle on a public road without a standard protective helmet.
